title: Insget - Video & Story Saver
summary: Insget is a reliable Instagram Downloader, Story Downloader, Video Downloader
description:
Insget is a simple, convenient and fast application for downloading photos and videos from instagram. It differs from other similar apps by its nice and smooth interface. It will never have intrusive full-screen ads after each action, as in other applications. With Insget, you can easily download photos, IG and IGTV videos from public and private accounts from instagram.

You can download videos from instagram and download photos from instagram and then send to Direct, Feed, Stories or any other application.

Insget allows you to download from instagram in two ways:
1) Open the menu and click "Copy Link" and then go to the Insget app and click on the "Download" button.
2) Open the menu and click "Share to", select the Insget app. Further, in order to download videos from instagram, nothing is required from you, the download from instagram will start automatically.

The application implements all the tools for easy viewing of saved photos and videos. In addition to the media files, the description of the post and its author are also saved. Therefore, you can download videos from instagram or download photos from instagram and access the content even when there is no Internet.

To download videos from instagram and download photos from instagram from public accounts, you do not need to log into your instagram account. You just need to copy the link or share it in the Insget app. Then the downloaded photo or video will be saved to the gallery.

In order to download photos from instagram or download videos from instagram from private accounts, you need to log in to the application and be subscribed to the account from which you want to download photos or videos. Otherwise, you won't be able to download videos from instagram and download photos from instagram.

If you need to download from instagram from a private account, then you can safely enter your username and password. Insget does not process, store or transfer this data to third parties. Therefore, you can safely download videos from instagram from private accounts without fear that your account will be stolen.

Application functions:
1) Download photos from instagram
2) Download videos from instagram
3) Download album (carousel) from instagram
4) Repost photos on Instagram or any other application
5) Repost videos on Instagram or any other application
6) Download photos from instagram from private account
7) Download videos from instagram from private account
8) Download an album (carousel) from instagram from private account
9) See photos in the app
10) Watch the video in the app
11) Open downloaded post on instagram
12) Copy post description and hashtags
13) Download from instagram stories
14) Download videos from instagram from profile, feed, story, IGTV
15) Download photos from instagram from profile, feed, history

If you need to save photos or videos from Instagram to your device, then the Insget application is what you need! Download Insget app now and have fun with it! Beautiful, fast, convenient and without intrusive ads!

The appearance of the application is made in a modern style. Support for various themes has been implemented. If you like the classic light theme, then at any time you can turn it on in the application settings. Thanks to this, you can download videos from instagram with great pleasure.

At the moment you can download stories from instagram. But for this you need to log in.

Notes:
1) Please, before downloading a photo or video from Instagram and reposting, obtain permission from the owner
2) We are not responsible for any infringement of intellectual property rights resulting from the unauthorized transfer of a video or photo
3) This app is not affiliated with Instagram

If you cannot download videos from instagram or photos, please let us know at spaple.developer@gmail.com and we will try to solve the problem.
